packageRules.description: One weekly PR for everything that is not a major bump
Jupyter base image uses a floating tag; pin and refresh its digest instead

JJava tags look like 1.0-a8, which is not semver. Only that alpha series counts as a version: loose versioning ranked the older 1.0-M3 milestone above 1.0-a7. Widen the pattern when JJava ships a beta or 1.0

customManagers.description: ARG <NAME>_VERSION=<value> lines in the Containerfile, each preceded by a renovate comment
